newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude cracks 2nd support level, tumbles late.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude cracks 2nd support level, tumbles late.

text.p: NYMEX crude oil futures prices extended steep losses in late trading Friday, breaking through a second key support level to post a 15-month low for the front-month contract.

Traders on the exchange floor said the session was marked by heavy liquidation of long positions held by commodity funds and other speculators, and shifted to waves of selling that were seen as new short positions.
At 1504 EDT, July crude was down 78 cents at $18.88 a barrel after breaking through key support at $18.96, a double-bottom on the spot chart created April 10.
